sentences.text:
---
CORAM: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath ---
For the Petitioner: Mr. Diwakar Jha, Advocate For the O.P-State: Mr. Shree Prakash Jha, A.P.P.
---
05 / 16.02.2024 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Ichak P.S. Case No. 54 of 2022 for the offences registered under sections 376 (2) (i) of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Miss Arpita Narayan, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Hazaribag.
3. On 01.04.2022, daughter of the Informant was enticed away by the accused Bablu Upadhyay.
It is alleged that the accused Bablu Upadhyay took the victim with him and sexually assaulted her for two days and thereafter released her.
4. Statement of the victim was recorded under section 164 of the Cr. P.C in which she has stated that one unknown person was also present with the accused Bablu Upadhyay during the occurrence.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is neither named in the FIR, nor the victim has named him in her statement under section 164 of the Cr. P.C and he has not been put on T.I. Parade.
It was submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 31.07.2023.
6. Shree Prakash Jha, learned A.P.P after going through the case diary, has opposed the prayer for bail, but conceded that the petitioner has not been put on T.I. Parade.

sentences.text:
Considering the aforesaid facts, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Miss Arpita Narayan, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class,
Hazaribag in connection with Ichak P.S. Case No. 54 of 2022.
